El local comercial,jamas tiene las tradicionales comidas al paso,ni fritas ni hamburguesas ni nada, prefieren decirte q al lado hay un restorante que por cierto se come muy rico y con buena vista ya q se ve  el rio

(Translated by Google)
The shop never has the usual fast food, no fried food, no hamburgers, nothing like that. They prefer to tell you that there's a restaurant next door that, by the way, has delicious food and a great view of the river.
